program.title: BSc in Chemistry
uncertain: total_required_credits is a calculated value: the PDF does not state a fixed total for the major; it is the sum of the required_credits of all groups (using the lower bound for credit ranges such as 3-6, 3-4, 4-7, 2-3).

The program consists of a common core plus Track Study: students follow one of the tracks (Biomolecular Chemistry, Core Chemistry, International Research Enrichment). Within the Core Chemistry Track, students may enroll in one of the options (Environmental and Analytical Chemistry, Materials Chemistry, Pure Chemistry). Summing all groups double-counts mutually exclusive tracks/options.
Remarks in the PDF note that CHEM 2410 and CHEM 3420 credit values will change to 4 starting from Fall 2027-28 (marked ** in the PDF).
The 'Core Chemistry Track Elective Course(s)' group (4-7 credits) does not have a specific course list in the PDF, so its courses array is empty.

The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 CHEM (4Y) (2025-26 intake)', i.e. the document is the 2025-26 intake curriculum rendered on a 2026-27 template; the year is recorded as 2025-26 per the intake year.
